|---|---|---|---|---|
| cytoscape.min.js | npm `cytoscape`, `dist/cytoscape.min.js` | 3.30.2 (published 2024-08-07) | 83e8c54a6bec655bfd81df07df605649c268af69aeca67a5ea2da54ea42dac81 | MIT, see cytoscape.LICENSE |

Inlined into every generated map so the file works with no network access.
Audited for `eval` and `new Function` (none), which lets the map's Content
Security Policy allow scripts by hash only. The test suite checks the hash.
